about: Canonical types for the Superintelligence Homepage's knowledge layer, the one source for every runtime. `npm run schema` generates JSON Schema, zod (Node/browser), pydantic (Python), protobuf with a gRPC service, Arrow (columnar, pyarrow), a JSON-LD context, OpenRPC (JSON-RPC) and Rust serde structs into schema/gen/. Field types: string, int, float, bool, datetime (ISO 8601 text), json (any), T[] (list), T? (optional), or another type's name. `ld` maps a field or type to a JSON-LD term (schema.org where one fits). Naming follows docs/NAMING.md: types are PascalCase, fields snake_case, ids qualified (namespace:id).

PublicationKind.about: Syntactically recognized publication link; never a claim of verified existence or evidence quality

ResolutionStatus.about: Static vocabulary resolution retains uncertainty rather than choosing an arbitrary alias match

ScopeRule.about: Which part of the REQ-003 rule decided

PublicationIdentity.about: Backend publication-link identity. key is an external grouping key, not an internal Tag.qid. basis records syntactic rules, not scientific support.

key.about: arxiv:, doi: or exact URL grouping key; null when unresolved

canonical_url.about: Original-source link from the recognized identity; not a fetched or verified resource

VocabularyResolution.about: Backend-only exact reference/alias candidates from static registries. Ambiguity is not identity equivalence or a merge instruction.

candidates.about: Known internal qualified IDs; empty when unresolved

basis.about: qualified-id or literal-alias; no fuzzy identity inference

Tag.about: A label on a story or chunk that explains itself: what it is (qid), the words that matched, and how it was made.

matched.about: Words in the text that produced the tag

via.about: Child topic that implied this parent topic

score.about: Confidence 0-1 when the method gives one (embedding similarity)

tags.about: Topics, organisations, benchmarks, people, concepts and glossary terms

scope.about: Why it is (or isn't) in the feed

Chunk.about: A passage of a story's text, the unit that gets tagged and embedded.

hash.about: sha1 of the text, so unchanged chunks aren't redone

Embedding.about: A vector for a chunk or concept. The default model is a free local hashing embedding; others can be plugged in as adapters.

subject.about: What is embedded: chunk:<story>:<ord> or concept:<id>

Edge.about: A link in the knowledge graph between two qualified ids, with the evidence for it.

weight.about: Strength (co-occurring chunks, or 1 for curated links)

evidence.about: Chunk or story ids that support it

taggers.about: Adapter ids to run; empty means all

EvalRequest.about: Evaluate an si-expr rule (lib/expr) on data.

rule.about: An si-expr AST, or the name of a rule in lib/rules

Knowledge.about: Served as JSON-RPC 2.0 at POST /api/knowledge/rpc (methods knowledge.tag, knowledge.evaluate) and described as a gRPC service in schema/gen/si.proto.

tag.about: Tag text with the registered taggers and decide scope
